Bundle tile init, TLS setup, URL parsing, metrics, and gRPC/plugin update handling.

# Purpose
This file defines the `bundle` tile for Firedancer. It sets up a network client that connects to a bundle server over HTTP or HTTPS, parses the configured endpoint, loads the local identity key, and creates the gRPC client used to send and receive bundle traffic. It also prepares OpenSSL support when TLS is enabled, including certificate store loading, custom memory allocation, and optional key logging. The file is not a general library; it is a tile implementation that is linked into the Firedancer runtime through the `fd_tile_bundle` run-tile descriptor at the end of the file.

The code also manages runtime state for the tile. It updates metrics, performs housekeeping, handles key switch completion, and publishes `block_engine_update` plugin messages when the bundle connection status changes. It defines the tile scratch layout, allowed file descriptors, and seccomp policy, then connects these pieces to the stem event loop through `fd_stem.c`.
